entryPoint.description: Library directory or barrel file to scan, relative to the workspace root. The installation guide's Builder Options describe how each is scanned.

prismProject.description: Angular project name for the Prism styleguide app

libraryProject.description: Library project name. Only used as the fallback for libraryImportPath.

port.description: Dev server port, passed to the prismProject's serve target

libraryImportPath.description: Package name used for imports in the generated manifest (defaults to libraryProject, then prismProject)

configFile.description: Path to the ng-prism config file, relative to the workspace root and inside it

cacheDir.description: Cache root for the generated manifest, written to <cacheDir>/<prismProject>/prism-manifest.ts. Default: <workspaceRoot>/ng-prism-cache. Relative paths resolve against the workspace root. The prism-manifest/* path mapping in tsconfig has to point there too.
